_comment: Example config for attaching any MCP-compatible client (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, etc.) directly to these servers for manual inspection/debugging over Streamable-HTTP -- copy relevant entries into that client's mcpServers config. Each server must already be running (`python -m mcp_servers.<name>_server`, one per port -- see .env.example) before a client connects. The Orchestrator/Planner Agent itself does not use this file; it connects to the same running servers programmatically via orchestrator/mcp_client.py.
_auth: Every server enforces the same HTTP Basic Auth credentials (MCP_USERNAME/MCP_PASSWORD in .env, default admin/pass123). The Authorization header below is `Basic base64(username:password)` -- regenerate it if you change those values, e.g. `python -c "import base64; print(base64.b64encode(b'admin:pass123').decode())"`.
